component: vdlu static curl (TLS transport for the headless fetch path)
note: runs as root after verify-before-exec: the SIGNED tools-manifest + binary sha256 are checked by ed25519-mini before first exec. TLS cert verify on-device via --capath /system/etc/security/cacerts (tested http=200).

build.toolchain: Android NDK r29 clang, api 28, cmake
build.linkage: DYNAMIC against bionic libc.so/libm.so/libdl.so only (no third-party .so, no closure)
build.curl_flags: HTTP_ONLY, mbedTLS backend, no http2/3/ssh/ldap/psl/idn2/zlib/brotli/zstd, MinSizeRel, stripped

tested_on_device: merlin1/edge (aarch64): curl 8.11.1 mbedTLS/3.6.7, https feed http=200 with system capath
